what: A three slider with slides attached to the inner face of a cylinder — the center slide is flat, and the farther out, the more slides wrap around the cylinder, with the top and bottom edges spreading up to 35% (radius 2.28 · camera 3.72). It turns by itself at .22 slides per second, glides with inertia when dragged (.94 per frame), and follows scrolling at .6×. On entry, slides fly in from 7 slides out at .08s intervals over 1.6s expo.out and settle. At 1024px and above, the 20% at each screen edge bulges like thick glass (+14% vertically) and blurs frosted (blur 42px · horizontal drag).

options.speed: Auto-rotation speed (sections per second), default .22 — 0 stops it
options.glass: Minimum screen width (px) to turn on the glass edge, default 1024
options.intro: 1 flies in (default), 0 stands in place right away
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Slide (child, hidden) — if there is an img, that photo is used, data-title and text go under the name below, and if href is present it goes there on click
options.fx:pick: Event raised when a slide is pressed (detail.index)

use: …
note: three r182. The canvas is drawn 35% beyond the panel top and bottom (as in the original) so open edges are not cropped — leave margin above and below the panel. The center slide size was measured and matched to about 41% of screen width in the original. Shaders are precompiled at setup
